How to play

Join your group

Scan the QR code on the projector. Create an account with your name and a four-digit PIN, then sign in and press Join the event. No game code or email is needed. Keep your PIN private.

You receive a player number. Your NCO can approve a public callsign. Use the same name and PIN to return on another device. If joining is closed or you forget your PIN, ask your NCO.

Your envelope

After the host releases roles, press and hold to reveal your own role. Hide it when finished. It also hides when you switch away from the tab.

Missions

Work with your group on the physical tasks. The NCO confirms scores. You can put your phone away until called back. All players continue physical missions after elimination.

Round table

Discuss the game, then vote when the organiser opens the ballot. Choose another active player in your own group. Your vote is saved only when the server accepts it, and you may change it until voting closes.

A tie gets one runoff between tied candidates. If that is tied too, the main host may explicitly draw between the tied candidates. No votes means an organiser must reopen or skip the ballot. Names and roles are revealed separately.

Night

Active Traitors choose an eligible Faithful in their group. A designated deciding Traitor resolves disagreement. The host locks the outcome privately, then reveals it at the scheduled time. There are at most two opportunities per group.

A supervised secret objective needs physical NCO verification. Reporting completion alone does not eliminate anyone. Optional shields protect against their designated murder opportunity, never banishment.

Private planning

Use preset messages, or short free text if enabled. Authorised organisers can read these messages. Eliminated Traitors lose new messages, secret objectives and murder actions.

After elimination

Keep helping your team earn mission points. Please stay out of accusations and keep other people's private identities secret. You cannot vote or take murder actions.

Results

After the third round table, surviving Traitors win their group. Catching all Traitors earlier gives the Faithful a deduction victory after already confirmed pending outcomes are handled. Mission scores are separate.

If the connection drops

Return to the tab or reconnect to load the latest state. A missing server receipt means your action is not confirmed. Tell your NCO if you need help. The website cannot wake a locked phone or appear over another app.
